start.title: Jesus Passes By
start.text:
Jesus walks the road to Jericho.
The whole town comes to see.

choices.text: Stay safe in your tax booth
choices.feedback: He may pass and never return.
Luke 19:3 — Zacchaeus was trying to see Jesus.

hide_consequence.title: Do Not Hide
hide_consequence.text:
This moment will not come again.
Go and see.

crowd.title: Too Short to See
crowd.text:
The crowd is tall and tight.
You cannot see him at all.

choices.feedback: Force will not open the way.
Do not turn back so soon.

choices.text: Look for another way to see
choices.feedback: Luke 19:3-4 — Zacchaeus was too short to see over the crowd, so he ran ahead to find another way.

push_consequence.title: Not by Force
push_consequence.text:
The crowd will not part for you.
Find another way.

choices.text: Look for another way to see

quit_consequence.title: Do Not Give Up
quit_consequence.text:
He is close. Just a little courage.
Keep going.

choices.text: Look for another way to see

tree.title: The Sycamore
tree.text:
An old sycamore leans over the road.
Its branches reach low.

choices.feedback: Luke 19:4 — Zacchaeus climbed a sycamore-fig tree to see Jesus as He was passing by.

shame_consequence.title: Climb Anyway
shame_consequence.text:
Pride keeps you from seeing him.
Let it go.

seen.title: He Looks Up
seen.text:
Jesus stops and looks straight at you.
"Zacchaeus, come down."

choices.text: Climb down at once with joy
choices.feedback: Luke 19:5-6 — Jesus told Zacchaeus to come down quickly, and Zacchaeus came down with joy.

hide_tree_consequence.title: Come Down
hide_tree_consequence.text:
He is calling you by name.
Do not be afraid.

choices.text: Climb down at once with joy

invite.title: I Must Stay With You
invite.text:
"Today I must stay at your house."
The words shake your heart.

choices.feedback: Luke 19:5-6 — Jesus said He must stay at Zacchaeus's house, and Zacchaeus welcomed Him joyfully.
Today is the day of grace.

refuse_consequence.title: Welcome Him
refuse_consequence.text:
He is not ashamed of you.
Open your door.

bargain_consequence.title: Today
bargain_consequence.text:
Grace comes today, not tomorrow.
Receive him now.

grumble.title: A Sinner's House
grumble.text:
The crowd mutters in disbelief.
"He goes in to a sinner's house."

choices.feedback: Their voices cannot define you now.
Luke 19:7-8 — While the crowd grumbled, Zacchaeus stood up and addressed the Lord.

stare_consequence.title: Stand Tall
stare_consequence.text:
Their judgment is not the last word.
Grace is.

repent.title: I Will Make It Right
repent.text:
Something new rises in you.
Wealth no longer holds your heart.

choices.text: Keep your gold and stay quiet
choices.feedback: A changed heart cannot stay silent.

choices.text: Give half to the poor today
choices.feedback: Luke 19:8 — Zacchaeus told the Lord that he would give half of his possessions to the poor.

keep_consequence.title: Let It Go
keep_consequence.text:
Closed hands cannot hold grace.
Open them.

choices.text: Give half to the poor today

feast_consequence.title: Bear Fruit
feast_consequence.text:
Real change shows in your hands.
Give freely.

choices.text: Give half to the poor today

ending.title: Salvation Has Come
ending.text:
"Today salvation has come to this house."
You are seen, you are restored.
